tb_keypoints_rowcol_to_uv — 2D typed op

• Data kinds: keypoints → keypoints

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "tb_keypoints_rowcol_to_uv", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

*The figure is the actual output on a synthetic 128×128 input. Left: input, right: output. Point clouds are drawn as a top-down scatter (brightness = z), 1-D series as a line plot, volumes as the maximum-intensity projection along z, videos as the middle frame, complex images as magnitude; return values that are not pictures are shown as the values themselves.*

*Knob a does not change the output (measured: identical at 0.1 / 0.5 / 0.9).*

*Knob b does not change the output (measured: identical at 0.1 / 0.5 / 0.9).*

Usage

Image points (row, col) → (u, v) = (col, row). The bridge between the two conventions of the keypoints sort.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

keypoints 型には 2 つの軸の約束が同居している(実測): calib.project_3d_point などは (row, col)、project_points / dlt_pose / pnp_ransac は (u, v) = (列, 行)。取り違えても例外は出ず、姿勢が鏡に映ったように出る(W2 の実測: t = (−0.565, 0.61, 3.21) のはずが (0.1, −0.05, 3.0))。列を入れ替えるだけだが、どちらの向きかを op 名に書くため

逆向きの keypoints_uv_to_rowcol と 2 本に分けてある(中身は同じ入れ替え)。

Args:

keypoints: (N, 2) の (row, col)。

Returns:

(N, 2) float64 の (u, v)。

Raises:

ValueError: (N, 2) でない / 非有限 / 空。

2-D 進化レジストリへ橋渡しした reprconv の op keypoints_rowcol_to_uv。実装は同じで、呼び出し規約だけ op(v, a, b) に合わせてある。この op に調整点は無く、a も b も使われない。
